title: Skill: acceptance names the command the gate actually runs, with its flags
description:
The skill's examples ('Can be verified by running tests', --acceptance "Tests pass" / "All validation tests pass") invite acceptance the gate cannot confirm. Observed in ticfac runs: per-tick gates went green while 7 of 10 relevant tests SKIPPED under -short, and a TS gate ran no vitest at all, so five behaviour ticks merged with their tests unrun by the gate.

Change: in the tick-writing guidance and tick-patterns.md, say acceptance names the exact command from [testing.commands] (or the repo's wrapper, e.g. its Makefile target) and the flags the gate runs it with; a test the gate does not run is not evidence — add it to the gate or name the gap in the acceptance. Replace the vague examples.
acceptance_criteria: No skill example uses 'tests pass' as a whole acceptance; the rule 'evidence runs under the gate's own flags, or the gap is named' appears in SKILL.md tick-writing guidance and tick-patterns.md with a good/bad example pair
closed_reason: Acceptance names the gate's command and flags: rule in SKILL.md + tick-patterns good/bad pair; vague 'tests pass' examples replaced
